name: Accordion
summary: A vertical stack of headers that each show or hide a panel of content, for long pages whose sections a reader scans and opens one or a few at a time. Use tabs when sections are peers viewed one at a time, and a tree when items nest or need arrow-key navigation.

inputs.name: openItems
inputs.description: Accordion: the values of the open items, when the caller controls them; a single value is accepted for one.

inputs.name: defaultOpenItems
inputs.description: Accordion: the items open at first, when the accordion controls itself.

inputs.name: multiple
inputs.description: Accordion: lets more than one panel be open at once; otherwise opening one closes the other.

inputs.name: collapsible
inputs.description: Accordion: lets the last open panel be closed, so all can be closed; otherwise one always stays open once any has been.

inputs.name: onToggle
inputs.description: Accordion: runs when a header is activated, with that item's value and the resulting open items.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: AccordionItem: the identity that openItems lists; any value, unique within the accordion.

inputs.name: disabled
inputs.description: AccordionItem: stops the header toggling its panel and draws it in the disabled colour.

inputs.name: size
inputs.description: AccordionHeader: the header's minimum height and text size.

inputs.name: expandIconPosition
inputs.description: AccordionHeader: whether the chevron leads the label or is pushed to the far end of the header.

inputs.name: inline
inputs.description: AccordionHeader: shrinks the header to its content width instead of the full row.

inputs.name: icon
inputs.description: AccordionHeader: an optional icon between the expand icon (at start) and the label.

inputs.name: as
inputs.description: AccordionHeader: the element wrapping the header button; use the heading level that fits the page outline.

inputs.name: children
inputs.description: AccordionHeader: the label; AccordionPanel: the content shown when open.

anatomy.name: Accordion
anatomy.description: The unstyled container of items; it owns which items are open.

anatomy.name: AccordionItem
anatomy.description: One header and its panel; unstyled, it carries the value and the disabled flag.

anatomy.name: AccordionHeader
anatomy.description: The row wrapper (a div or heading) with a transparent background and medium radius.

anatomy.name: Header button
anatomy.description: The full-width flex row that is the hit target: expand icon, optional icon and label on one line, vertically centred.

anatomy.name: Expand icon
anatomy.description: A chevron at 20px (fontSizeBase500) that points to the end when closed and down when open.

anatomy.name: Icon
anatomy.description: An optional leading icon at 20px, before the label.

anatomy.name: Label
anatomy.description: The header text in the size's type.

anatomy.name: AccordionPanel
anatomy.description: The content under an open header, inset horizontally; not rendered while closed.

variants.description: 32px minimum height with fontSizeBase200 text; the line height stays body1's.
Chevron first, spacingHorizontalS before the icon or label; the button pads spacingHorizontalMNudge at the start and spacingHorizontalM at the end.

The chevron grows to fill the remaining width and right-aligns, with spacingHorizontalS before it; the button pads spacingHorizontalMNudge at the end, and spacingHorizontalM at the start when there is no icon.
Header root is inline-block and the button inline-flex, so the header is only as wide as its content.

layout.text: Accordion and AccordionItem add no styles: items stack in normal block flow with no gap, divider or border between them.
The header root has no margin, a colorTransparentBackground fill, colorNeutralForeground1 text and borderRadiusMedium corners, which only the focus outline makes visible.

The button is a full-width, border-box flex row, items centred vertically, no border, padded 0 vertically, spacingHorizontalMNudge at the start and spacingHorizontalM at the end, at least 44px tall, in body1 type; it inherits the header's colours.
Small lowers the minimum height to 32px and the font to fontSizeBase200, keeping lineHeightBase300.
Large sets fontSizeBase400 on lineHeightBase400 and extra-large fontSizeBase500 on lineHeightBase500; both keep the 44px minimum height.

The expand icon fills the row's height and centres its glyph, sized by fontSizeBase500 and lineHeightBase500 (a 20px icon) at every header size; at start it has spacingHorizontalS after it, at end it grows to fill the free space, right-aligns the glyph and has spacingHorizontalS before it.
With the expand icon at the end the button's end padding drops to spacingHorizontalMNudge, and its start padding rises to spacingHorizontalM when there is no icon slot.
The icon fills the row's height, centres its glyph at fontSizeBase500 on lineHeightBase500 and has spacingHorizontalS after it.
The panel has no vertical margin and spacingHorizontalM on each side, aligning its content with the header's end padding; it sets no type or colour of its own.

states.text: Rest: transparent background and colorNeutralForeground1 text and icons.
The pointer becomes a hand; no colour changes on hover or press, since the styles file declares no hover or active rule and no transition.
Keyboard focus draws the default createFocusOutlineStyle indicator on the button: a 2px colorStrokeFocus2 outline just outside the button, following borderRadiusMedium.
Open: the panel is rendered below its header and the chevron points down.
Closed: the panel is not rendered and the chevron points to the end.
Text and icons take colorNeutralForegroundDisabled, any background image is removed and the pointer shows not-allowed; the header does not toggle.

behaviour.text: Clicking the header button, or Enter or Space while it is focused, toggles its item's panel and runs onToggle with the item's value and the new open items.
Without multiple, opening one item closes the open one; without collapsible, activating the only open item does nothing, so a panel stays open once one has been.
openItems makes the caller own the open set; defaultOpenItems seeds it when the accordion owns it.

The panel's collapseMotion is Fluent's Collapse: opening animates the panel's height from 0px, its whitespace and its opacity from 0 together over durationNormal with curveEasyEaseMax; closing is symmetric in duration and curve, fading opacity and collapsing height and whitespace to 0px with no stagger between them.
Arrow-key navigation between headers (linear or circular) exists but is deprecated; by default headers are reached with Tab like any button.

keyboard: Tab moves between header buttons and into open panels
Enter and Space toggle the focused header's panel
semantics: the header button reports aria-expanded and aria-controls pointing at its panel
a disabled item's button reports aria-disabled
wrap the button in a heading (as h2 to h6) so the header joins the page outline
the panel is a region labelled by its header

notes.text: The header's 44px (32px small) minimum height and zero vertical padding are constants in the styles file.
Small changes only the font size, not the line height (body1's lineHeightBase300 stays), and large and extra-large change the type but not the 44px minimum height; medium has no class of its own.
The header has no hover, pressed or selected colour at all; an implementation that tints the row on hover departs from Fluent.
The default chevron (ChevronRight, rotated 90 degrees when open, or its mirror under RTL) and the aria wiring are set in the header's hook, which is not vendored.

The styles files have no forced-colors rules. The focus outline turns Highlight through createFocusOutlineStyle; text follows its tokens (CanvasText, GrayText when disabled) and the transparent background shows the page.
